feed.title: Accessible by default: what changed
feed.subtitle: What moved in the platform and the standards, and what it changed on accessible-by-default.dev. Newest first.

entry.title: Standard: The legal map became a standards map
entry.summary: The legal map became a standards map: laws sit in the row of the WCAG version they cite, and each opens to show how many layers sit between it and the criterion you test.

entry.title: Standard: A new WCAG 3.0 working draft
entry.summary: A new WCAG 3.0 working draft: one bar of core requirements, with supplemental requirements and assertions as extras you report. The timeline entry follows it.

entry.title: Standard: EN 301 549 V4.1.1 is published
entry.summary: ETSI published EN 301 549 V4.1.1, quoting WCAG 2.2 AA. Until the Official Journal cites it, 2.1 AA stays the bar on the map.

entry.title: Showcase: Firefox 155 ships typed attr()
entry.summary: Firefox 155 ships typed attr(), so that showcase now runs in two engines; Safari has it in Technology Preview.

entry.title: Showcase: Media state pseudo-classes reach Baseline
entry.summary: Chrome 152 shipped the media state pseudo-classes, the third engine, so :playing and :paused now work everywhere without script.

entry.title: Proof: The audit room
entry.summary: The audit room: a page broken on purpose, twelve barriers, answers included.
